events.verdict: Green (HOU) maintains a legal guarding position during Ivey's (DET) drive to the basket and shot attempt and the contact is incidental. Additionally, Sengun (HOU) legally contests the shot attempt at the basket.
Harris (PHI) grazes Sengun's (HOU) head before he enters his upward shooting motion and the contact is marginal.
Eason (HOU) maintains a legal guarding position during Ivey's (DET) drive to the basket and cleanly blocks the shot attempt.
Brooks (HOU) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Sengun (HOU) inadvertently steps on Stewart's (DET) foot while he is in a legally obtained position and the incidental contact causes Sengun to lose his balance.
Sengun (HOU) and Stewart (DET) briefly engage and disengage during the rebound.
Cunningham (DET) commits a take foul on VanVleet (HOU).
Cunningham (DET) makes clean contact with the ball to block Sengun's (HOU) dunk attempt and any contact with his hand on the ball is incidental.
Cunningham (DET) returns to the floor and gains possession of the ball while stepping on the out-of-bounds line.
Brooks (HOU) briefly grasps Cunningham's (DET) arm during the rebound.
Stewart (DET) impedes Sengun (HOU) in the post.
VanVleet (HOU) initiates illegal contact across Cunningham's (DET) arm in order to get to the ball.
Cunningham (DET) crosses the plane of the free throw line before the ball makes contact with the rim.
Ivey (DET) places his off-arm against Brooks (HOU) and releases before stepping back.
Sengun (HOU) and Stewart (DET) mutually engage during the rebound.
Eason (HOU) grabs and pulls Harris's (DET) shorts, affecting his shot attempt at the basket.
